triggerCases.prompt: Grill me on this migration plan. Ask questions until there are no material gaps, then wait for my confirmation before we implement it.
Interview me one question at a time to stress-test this architecture and surface every unresolved decision.
Poke holes in this plan and return one consolidated list of concerns. Do not ask me follow-up questions.
Draft an implementation plan from this approved specification without interviewing me.
Review this pull request for correctness and test coverage, then draft the findings.

outputCases.prompt: Grill me on this async export plan. Ask one question at a time until it has no material gaps. Do not modify or implement anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A read-only interview that uses the supplied repository facts and asks one dependency-ready permission question with a recommendation.
assertions: The response uses the supplied repository facts instead of asking the user to rediscover them.
The response asks exactly one answerable decision question and focuses it on download authorization after an administrator's role changes.
The response gives a clear recommended answer with a brief reason or trade-off while leaving the decision to the user.
The response does not produce a completed plan, edit files, implement code, commit, publish, or claim convergence.

outputCases.prompt: We have finished grilling this plan. Check whether it is ready and close the session if nothing material is missing.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A compact convergence check that does not invent work, asks for final user confirmation, and stops before planning or implementation.
assertions: The response summarizes the resolved decisions, intentional non-goals or deferrals, and residual risks or evidence gaps from the supplied context.
The response marks the plan ready for confirmation rather than inventing an unrelated low-impact question.
The response asks exactly one final confirmation question and does not claim user confirmation has already occurred.
The response does not create a plan artifact, edit files, implement code, commit, or publish.
